svg.title: SESAME's key duplicator: one cut per sign-in step
svg.desc: SESAME's key duplicator traces the cas key from the front page and cuts its five notches and tip, one sign-in step each: GET /login (A guest is sent to the login route); /cas/login?service=… (the user must go to the identity provider); ?ticket=ST-… (Only ST- service tickets are accepted); /cas/serviceValidate (SESAME validates it once); findOrImportUser(Identity) (A new session ID at login); POST /logout → /cas/logout (Logout shuts the door). Then ab1234 is in.

g.text: A guest is sent to the login route
the user must go to the identity provider
Only ST- service tickets are accepted.
A new session ID at login
